verdict.rationale: Docs confirm serverless endpoints serving '100+ open-source models' with per-token pricing, no provisioning latency, and OpenAI-compatible API for easy model switching, and community evidence corroborates real-world use of Llama-family models on the platform. However, the evidence pack never explicitly enumerates Qwen, DeepSeek, or GPT-OSS by name, so full breadth across all cited model families isn't directly confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming Qwen/DeepSeek/GPT-OSS as catalog entries, and independent verification of catalog breadth beyond the generic '100+ models' claim.
